statement: Unlock the Printer via Construction Bench; 9 upgrades each give 1 additional character access to the Printer.
First Hoggindaz quest: turn on the Refinery and cycle about an hour to get the required Redox Salt.
Second quest: place a trap in Jungle Slimes map in World 1; first finish Trapper's Folley quest from the Lord of the Hunt NPC.
Last quest: build the red and orange signposts in the Construction Bench; located at the 3D Printer and Wizard Tower.
Completing the quests gives the Printer Sampling Talent Book found in the Star Talent tabs.
Initially only first character slot has Printer access until Construction upgrades unlock each further character up to characters 7 through 9.
Initially you only have 2 small sample boxes and 1 printer slot.
Gem shop More Sample Slots unlocks third and fourth sample slots for 200 and 300 gems.
Crystal 3D Printer gem purchase gives second printing slot to duplicate an item or print two separate items.
Small squares show sampled items per character; large squares show icon and items per hour being printed.
Printed items go directly into Storage Chest with no manual collecting; free resources once set up.
Trash Can icon deletes a sample you no longer want and frees the slot; unnecessary when only upgrading sample size.
Printer Sampling talent needs minimum 1 point giving 10% of AFK gain rate; up to 100 points gives 18% base sample rate.
After adding talent points click Assign Attacks and drag it onto your Action Bar.
Go to any skill or monster you want items from; click attacks then Sample Size; a number above your head shows the sample gained.
Clicking the sample icon shows printing rate; example 1500 Spore Caps per hour; can duplicate; all automated.
Sample size is based on your AFK gain rate so anything raising AFK gain rate increases it.
Raise AFK gain rate by increasing damage; movement speed; weapon attack speed; and multi-kill shown in AFK info.
For skills increase Skill Efficiency and Skilling Speed to raise AFK gain rate.
Star Talent Printer Sampling raises basic sampling size from 10 to 18%.
Salt Lick has bonus making samples for the 3D Printer up to 10% bigger.
Family Bonuses Maestro bonus increases Printer Sampling Size based on his maximum level.
Post Office Utility Box upgrade increases Printer Sample Size up to 3.33%.
Alchemy yellow bubble Sample It increases sample size; currently 4.26% for him.
Snow Slurry vial gives easy 3 to 5% sample size depending on getting Snowballs and Tier 3 liquid.
World 3 Task Merit Shop gives 0.5% sample size per point; additional 5% total.
World 3 Prayer Obelisk Royal Sampler gives 15% sample size base with -30% XP gain.
To remove the XP penalty you must unequip all samples on that character; be careful using this.
Upgrade Royal Sampler with Rooted Souls; increases sample size but also increases the XP penalty.
World 1 Sampling Stamp (Stample) gives additional sample size bonus; small at first but adds up over time.
Arcade Shop has an upgrade to increase sample size.
